summary: Iteration 42 - ACTOOS PRO Enhanced Signature Validation Workflow Testing Complete. All backend APIs verified: POST /api/interventions/{id}/complete-with-signature (with type_signataire, relation_signataire, email/telephone), POST /api/interventions/{id}/validate (admin validation), POST /api/interventions/{id}/reject-validation (rejection with reason), GET /api/interventions/pending-validation (list awaiting validation). Backend: 18/18 tests passed (100%). Frontend: SignaturePad component verified with all required elements. Fixed route ordering bug for /pending-validation endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Route ordering bug - /pending-validation was defined after /{intervention_id} causing 404 errors. Moved route before parameterized route.
VERIFIED: POST /api/interventions/{id}/complete-with-signature accepts type_signataire (client/tiers), relation_signataire, email_signataire, telephone_signataire
VERIFIED: Pro/Enterprise plan auto-validates signatures to 'terminee' status directly
VERIFIED: Startup plan would set status to 'en_validation' requiring admin approval (not testable with demo account)
VERIFIED: POST /api/interventions/{id}/validate requires admin role and moves intervention from en_validation to terminee
VERIFIED: POST /api/interventions/{id}/reject-validation requires admin role and reason, moves back to en_cours
VERIFIED: GET /api/interventions/pending-validation returns list of interventions with en_validation status (admin only)
VERIFIED: SignaturePad component has 'Le client' button (data-testid='signer-type-client')
VERIFIED: SignaturePad component has 'Autre personne' button (data-testid='signer-type-tiers')
VERIFIED: SignaturePad shows Relation dropdown when tiers selected (data-testid='relation-select')
VERIFIED: SignaturePad pre-fills client name/email/phone when 'Le client' selected
VERIFIED: Interventions.jsx has 'En validation' option in status filter dropdown
VERIFIED: Interventions.jsx detail page shows Validate/Reject buttons for en_validation status (admin only)
seed_data_creation: Created test interventions with TEST_ prefix during testing - cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Enhanced signature validation workflow fully tested. Key findings: 1) /pending-validation route was incorrectly placed after /{intervention_id} - FIXED by moving it before parameterized routes, 2) complete-with-signature accepts all enhanced fields (type_signataire, relation_signataire, email, telephone), 3) Pro/Enterprise plan auto-validates to 'terminee', Startup plan would go to 'en_validation', 4) SignaturePad component has all required UI elements with proper data-testid attributes, 5) Interventions page has 'En validation' status filter and Validate/Reject buttons for admin.
